<?php
/**
 * Secure Document Management API
 * Handles document retrieval with strict access controls
 * Uses content-addressed storage with integrity verification
 */

class DocumentStore {
    private string $storageRoot;
    private array $allowedPrefixes = ['public/', 'shared/', 'reports/'];
    private int $maxPathLen;
    
    public function __construct(string $root) {
        $this->storageRoot = realpath($root) . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR;
        $this->maxPathLen = 4096;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validates that the document path is within allowed prefixes.
     * Uses length-bounded comparison for efficiency on large path sets.
     */
    public function isAllowedPath(string $docPath): bool {
        // Normalize path separators
        $docPath = str_replace('\\', '/', $docPath);
        
        // Remove any null bytes
        $docPath = str_replace("\0", '', $docPath);
        
        // Check for traversal sequences
        if (strpos($docPath, '..') !== false) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Verify path matches an allowed prefix
        foreach ($this->allowedPrefixes as $prefix) {
            if (strncmp($docPath, $prefix, strlen($prefix)) === 0) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    /**
     * Computes the effective path by applying user's namespace offset.
     * The offset determines which portion of the logical path maps to storage.
     * 
     * @param string $logicalPath - The full logical document path
     * @param int $namespaceOffset - Byte offset for namespace resolution
     * @return string - The effective storage-relative path
     */
    public function resolveNamespacedPath(string $logicalPath, int $namespaceOffset): string {
        // Ensure offset doesn't exceed path length
        $pathLen = strlen($logicalPath);
        
        // Calculate effective length for the prefix portion
        $effectiveLen = $pathLen - $namespaceOffset;
        
        // Safety: if effective length is negative or zero, reject
        if ($effectiveLen <= 0) {
            return '';
        }
        
        // Safety: cap at max path length
        if ($effectiveLen > $this->maxPathLen) {
            $effectiveLen = $this->maxPathLen;
        }
        
        // Extract the effective path starting from the offset
        return substr($logicalPath, $namespaceOffset, $effectiveLen);
    }
    
    /**
     * Main document retrieval with full security pipeline.
     * Pipeline: parse request → resolve namespace → validate → fetch
     */
    public function getDocument(array $request): array {
        $logicalPath = $request['path'] ?? '';
        $namespace = $request['namespace'] ?? 0;
        
        // Type coercion: namespace comes from HTTP params as string
        // PHP_INT_SIZE is 8 on 64-bit systems
        $namespaceOffset = intval($namespace);
        
        // Resolve the effective path using namespace offset
        $effectivePath = $this->resolveNamespacedPath($logicalPath, $namespaceOffset);
        
        if (empty($effectivePath)) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid path resolution', 'code' => 400];
        }
        
        // Security gate: verify the effective path is allowed
        if (!$this->isAllowedPath($effectivePath)) {
            return ['error' => 'Access denied', 'code' => 403];
        }
        
        // Fetch the document
        return $this->fetchDocument($effectivePath);
    }
    
    private function fetchDocument(string $relativePath): array {
        $fullPath = $this->storageRoot . $relativePath;
        
        // Final realpath check
        $resolved = realpath($fullPath);
        if ($resolved === false) {
            return ['error' => 'Document not found', 'code' => 404];
        }
        
        // Verify still within storage root
        if (strpos($resolved, $this->storageRoot) !== 0) {
            return ['error' => 'Access denied', 'code' => 403];
        }
        
        $content = file_get_contents($resolved);
        return ['content' => $content, 'code' => 200];
    }
}

/**
 * Request handler with namespace computation from session context.
 * Namespaces allow multi-tenant path isolation.
 */
class RequestHandler {
    private DocumentStore $store;
    
    public function __construct(DocumentStore $store) {
        $this->store = $store;
    }
    
    /**
     * Computes namespace offset from user context.
     * The offset is derived from the tenant prefix length.
     */
    public function computeNamespaceOffset(string $tenantId, string $path): int {
        // Tenant prefix format: "{tenantId}/"
        $prefixLen = strlen($tenantId) + 1;
        
        // For paths that don't start with tenant prefix, offset is 0
        if (strncmp($path, $tenantId . '/', $prefixLen) !== 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        
        return $prefixLen;
    }
    
    /**
     * Handle incoming API request.
     * Supports direct path access and tenant-scoped access.
     */
    public function handle(array $params): array {
        $mode = $params['mode'] ?? 'direct';
        
        if ($mode === 'tenant') {
            $tenantId = $params['tenant_id'] ?? '';
            $path = $params['path'] ?? '';
            
            // Validate tenant ID format (alphanumeric only)
            if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$/', $tenantId)) {
                return ['error' => 'Invalid tenant ID', 'code' => 400];
            }
            
            $offset = $this->computeNamespaceOffset($tenantId, $path);
            return $this->store->getDocument(['path' => $path, 'namespace' => $offset]);
        }
        
        // Direct mode: namespace offset from query parameter
        // This allows advanced clients to specify custom namespace resolution
        $offset = $params['ns_offset'] ?? '0';
        $path = $params['path'] ?? '';
        
        return $this->store->getDocument(['path' => $path, 'namespace' => $offset]);
    }
}

// Application entry point
$store = new DocumentStore(__DIR__ . '/documents');
$handler = new RequestHandler($store);

$params = [
    'mode' => $_GET['mode'] ?? 'direct',
    'path' => $_GET['path'] ?? '',
    'ns_offset' => $_GET['ns_offset'] ?? '0',
    'tenant_id' => $_GET['tenant_id'] ?? ''
];

$result = $handler->handle($params);
http_response_code($result['code']);
header('Content-Type: application/json');
echo json_encode($result);
